reason: Both identify the same root cause: closeMenu fails to remove the document click listener registered by openMenu (via document.addEventListener('click', onClickOutside)), so it keeps firing after close. The reviewer's mention of listeners accumulating "across view transitions" and stale ones repeatedly triggering closeMenu/focus changes is a paraphrase of the same underlying mechanism (stale accumulating listeners still firing and comparing against menu/toggle elements), not a different bug.
